subject: MSA / Order Form - carve-out language for trade secret & confidentiality breaches
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aureliusbio.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Price <dprice@aureliusbio.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA redlines — confidentiality / trade secret carve-out

Hannah,

Thanks for sending the draft MSA. Our legal team reviewed the limitation of liability and proposed a carve-out for breaches involving trade secrets and confidential information. High-level ask: carve those breaches out of the monetary cap and allow Aurelius to seek consequential damages and injunctive relief. Attached is a redline with the suggested language (Aurelius_Redlines_v3.docx).

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can Redwood confirm whether you can accept an exclusion for willful or grossly negligent misuse of confidential information (not mere negligence)?
- If Redwood needs a narrower scope, would you consider an evidentiary standard tied to Ropes & Gray review and forensic logs?

Samira
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Aurelius Biotech

Attachment: Aurelius_Redlines_v3.docx (MS Word redline)

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aureliusbio.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality / trade secret carve-out

Samira — thanks, received. Looping in Ben (sales lead) and Karthik (legal ops) to coordinate. Quick response at a high level: Redwood is open to narrow carve-outs for intentional, willful misappropriation of trade secrets. We need to balance that with our general liability cap model — broad uncapped exposure creates procurement and pricing issues we can’t absorb.

Can your team accept language that:
- Limits uncapped recovery to "willful and intentional" acts of misappropriation as determined by a court or independent arbitrator;
- Requires Aurelius to provide specified forensic evidence (audit logs, access timelines) before uncapped relief becomes available; and
- Preserves injunctive relief while capping monetary recovery except when the evidentiary standard is met.

I attached a short text file with proposed phrasing (Redwood_MSA_proposed_clause.txt). If that looks workable, Ben and I can schedule a call with your legal and Ropes & Gray next week.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_MSA_proposed_clause.txt

From: Daniel Price <dprice@aureliusbio.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@aureliusbio.com>
Cc: OutsideCounsel - Ropes & Gray <rgr-llp@ropesgray.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 13:26:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality / trade secret carve-out

Hannah, Samira — appreciate the quick reply. A few clarifications from Aurelius legal:
- We are not seeking to make Redwood unlimitedly liable for any data incident. The primary concern is that trade secret disclosures can cause harm beyond token damages.
- We can live with an internal "evidentiary trigger" (forensic logs + Ropes & Gray confirmation) to move to uncapped monetary relief, but we want the threshold to allow prompt remedial compensation rather than protracted discovery fights.

Proposed middle ground: a two-tier approach — (1) injunctive relief always available; (2) monetary uncapping only if (a) demonstrable exfiltration of trade-secret-marked data occurs, AND (b) independent counsel (Ropes & Gray) issues a written determination that the event constitutes willful misappropriation.

Would Redwood accept that limited, counsel-triggered approach? Also, please confirm what log retention + sampling we can rely on — our security team asked whether Redwood retains request/response metadata for 90 days by default.

—Daniel
Senior Counsel, Aurelius Biotech

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Price <dprice@aureliusbio.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@aureliusbio.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality / trade secret carve-out

Daniel — thanks. Karthik from Legal Ops here. We reviewed the two-tier approach and have these proposed guardrails to make it operational: 

1) Definitions: "Trade Secret" must be narrowly defined to mirror the Uniform Trade Secrets Act elements and require that the Customer has clearly marked the data as trade secret in the Product (metadata flag or separate upload).
2) Evidence: Redwood will provide access to audit logs and token-level metadata for a 90-day window. For extremely old requests, we can provide sampling but not full transaction reconstruction.
3) Counsel-trigger: We can accept an independent counsel determination from Ropes & Gray to unblock uncapped monetary recovery, provided the counsel's role is limited to an objective determination of willfulness and causation (not a damages quantification).
4) Temporal carve-out cap: If uncapped recovery is triggered, monetary recovery for direct damages remains uncapped for claims directly tied to the trade-secret disclosure; consequential damages beyond provable lost profits would remain excluded unless a court finds willfulness.

If Aurelius is okay with the definition and audit-log mechanics, we can take your redline and fold these guardrails in. Also attaching Audit-logs-sampling-guide.pdf to show what we can produce.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Audit-logs-sampling-guide.pdf

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aureliusbio.com>, Daniel Price <dprice@aureliusbio.com>
Cc: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 11:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality / trade secret carve-out

Samira / Daniel — Ben here. From a commercial perspective we can accept narrow, well-defined carve-outs tied to willful misappropriation and independent counsel confirmation. A couple of operational asks so Procurement doesn't stall: 
- If the counsel-trigger path is used, can Ropes & Gray commit to a 14-day written determination timeline? We need a predictable cadence so our PM and support teams can coordinate remediation and potential disclosures to our infra partners.
- For pricing: uncapped exposure for trade-secret events will require us to move the Order Form to an enterprise tier with higher minimums. If Aurelius wants the more limited carve-out (e.g., uncapped only after counsel determination), we can keep current pricing; if you want an always-uncapped carve-out, we'd need to reprice.

Happy to jump on a 30-min call to finalize. Hannah, can you propose two slots Thursday?

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@aureliusbio.com>
To: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA redlines — confidentiality / trade secret carve-out

All — thanks for the thoughtful responses and the audit-log sample. Aurelius is comfortable moving forward with the two-tier, counsel-triggered approach with the following final items to be added to the MSA: 
- Exact definition of Trade Secret (per UTSA + customer marking requirement)
- Ropes & Gray to provide a written determination within 14 calendar days of a joint evidence package submission; if Ropes & Gray misses the deadline, matter escalates to arbitration for expedited resolution
- Redwood to retain request/response metadata for 90 days and provide a sampling methodology in the SOW
- A narrow carve-out allowing uncapped direct monetary recovery only for willful misappropriation as determined by counsel; incidental consequential damages remain excluded unless a court finds willfulness after full adjudication

Please incorporate these into a consolidated redline and send back. If we can get the final redline and Docusign placeholders by next Wednesday, procurement will execute.

Samira Khan
Director, Strategic Sourcing
Aurelius Biotech

Attachments referenced: Aurelius_Redlines_v3.docx, Audit-logs-sampling-guide.pdf
